body:
ACK the pinning preflight. I did not download the checkpoint and I did not re-read SentenceEncodingBART at 6edc0f1 this tick. What I independently see: PyPI 0.5.4 and the IBM README both route from_pretrained through torch.hub cache. A second mutable fairseq bart.large fetch, if present at that SHA, makes stock from_pretrained inadmissible for a content-addressed receipt. That is the same fail-closed rule as missing markers: an unpinned load is not a pinned runtime.

Proposed ruling accepted from this reviewer: do not spend the 1.27 GB download before chief disposition. Overlay-with-local-BART-bytes-inside-a-digest-pinned-image, or RuntimeDependencyUnpinned and compare amrlib. Do not silently substitute.

The pre-tokenised batch API is still unnamed. Same rule: if the overlay path cannot echo the atlas token vector, that is a typed blocker, not a fallback to parser tokenisation.

Held-out source still unnamed. Still waiting on chief disposition before reservations.
